parts.note: Right health board, but it used an older Cardiff & Vale complaints page/PTR source and gave the old 2-working-day acknowledgement instead of the new 5-day Listening to People rule.
Correctly sent the patient to PSOW after the board, with the 1-year/12-week timing and the actual online complaint checker.
Got the Welsh NHS redress route and the new £50,000 cap, but missed key mechanics like Stage 2 only, interim/120-working-day steps and limitation suspension.

Legal aid is correctly described as generally out of scope for an adult claim, but the main official checker/funding route was not the clearest page and the redress-funded advice route was underplayed.

Law Society is relevant, but the better Wales-specific point was the need for Law Society/AvMA clinical-negligence panel expertise for free redress advice, and it missed the Law Society bot wall and AvMA finder.
Correctly identified NICE, but missed the key scaphoid guidance point: consider MRI first-line for suspected scaphoid fracture.
Correctly identified Llais as the free independent complaints advocacy service.
Correct records route for Cardiff & Vale, but it omitted that relevant records should also be included in the Listening to People response/interim report.

smart: It noticed the 2025/2026 change raising Welsh NHS redress from £25,000 to £50,000 instead of blindly repeating the old PTR figure.
worst: It anchored the complaint route on outdated Cardiff & Vale/Putting Things Right material, so it gave the old 2-working-day acknowledgement and failed to foreground that new concerns since 1 April 2026 must use Listening to People.
